eligibility.method: Conservative name-wide target scan plus selected-source review; not a general scope proof.

rootChecks: Reviewed generator, pure builder and exact private-plan correction.
Reviewed independently derived original/output AST, retained-body/import/export/order/tail comparison and three parseable corruption controls.
Reviewed complete-wire and event-trace parity on the default graph, plus six pending/backpressure/original-clock comparisons.
Verified 84 manifest members across source and two independent packets and all eleven runtime hashes against accepted EMIT-R2.
scope: Eleven byte-exact runtime modules, one strict lexical closure and namespace instance per module, fixed single emitMetadata tail.
Offline AST plan generation; pure runtime building has no parser, fs, eval, dynamic import or native observation.
Exact source Buffer snapshots and a private parsed snapshot of the canonical plan bytes checked against the fixed pin.
Independent AST proof derives originals afresh rather than trusting the generated plan as expected output.
Assembled and unassembled default-graph fixtures use real crypto on tiny fake bytes; no fabricated target-hash success.
Config and complete executable source caps remain independent; source sizes do not establish output-wire sizes.

history.reason: An input Proxy hook changed an import map after the plan hash check; the builder emitted different source while reporting the original plan pin. No generated source was executed in that reproduction.

limits: This is a fixed selected-source linker, not a general ESM bundler, scope engine or hostile-runtime proof.

The offline inspector permits variable initializer calls. Exact selected source pins and renewed eligibility review, not a generic initializer filter, are the safety boundary. Changed selected initializer bytes are refused by the builder.

Full COMPLETE and UNKNOWN assembled sessions, assembled late error/reentry and pending collection were not exercised. Accepted emitter evidence and exact body/wiring proof remain separate from these missing assembled cases.
No actual stdout, child, target native success, host execution, transport qualification or durable publication.
Envelope, authenticated runner, fresh admission and exact bounded GO remain required before a metadata host job.
next: Implement and independently verify the pure metadata envelope, then derive the authenticated runner under a separate bounded local contract.
